definitions.gloss: emergency meeting; extraordinary meeting; ad hoc meeting
definitions.explanation: A meeting convened outside the regular schedule to address an urgent or unexpected matter that requires immediate discussion.

examples.japanese: {臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}が{招集|しょうしゅう}された。
{問題|もんだい}が{発生|はっせい}したため、{急遽|きゅうきょ}{臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}を{開|ひら}くことになった。
examples.english: A problem arose, so it was decided to hold an emergency meeting on short notice.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}が{全部門|ぜんぶもん}の{責任者|せきにんしゃ}を{集|あつ}めて{臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}を{行|おこな}い、{対策|たいさく}を{協議|きょうぎ}した。
examples.english: The president gathered all department heads for an emergency meeting to discuss countermeasures.

notes:
A compound of {臨時|りんじ} (extraordinary, ad hoc) + {会議|かいぎ} (meeting, conference). Conveys urgency — used when a situation demands immediate collective discussion outside the normal meeting schedule.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}を{開|ひら}く: to hold an emergency meeting
- {臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}を{招集|しょうしゅう}する: to convene an emergency meeting
- {臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}が{行|おこな}われる: an emergency meeting is held
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}: urgent emergency meeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定期会議|ていきかいぎ}: regular meeting (scheduled at fixed intervals)
- {緊急会議|きんきゅうかいぎ}: emergency meeting (even more urgent in tone)
- {臨時総会|りんじそうかい}: extraordinary general meeting (formal corporate/organizational term)
